content:
Apple Watch offers a wide range of customisable watch faces so you can personalise your timepiece, and the popular Modular watch face is set to become even more versatile in watchOS 27.

watchOS 27 adds 13 new colour options for the Modular face and introduces more functional complications.

Modular has long been a popular Apple Watch face, thanks to its versatility and rich customisation options.

The face is so popular that Apple has even launched variants such as Modular Compact and Modular Ultra, with the latest being Siri Modular.

But the standard "Modular" face has also been continuously improved. In watchOS 26, Apple added 13 new colour options to this face, making it easier for users to customise.

Here are the new colours for Modular in watchOS 26:

  • Olive Green
  • Wine Red
  • Sand
  • Magenta
  • Sage Green
  • Wildflower Blue
  • Navy Blue
  • Light Ochre
  • Light Blue
  • Limestone
  • Camel
  • Sage
  • Mulberry

When customising the Modular face, you can find all of the above colours in the colour settings page in watchOS 26. You can also scroll to the bottom and tap the "+" button to browse and add previous colours via "tap to add more colours."

In addition to these new colours, Modular also benefits from the latest complications exclusive to Apple Watch Ultra 3 and Series 11.

The complications come in various sizes for daily steps, heart rate, readiness and more, so you can track important health metrics directly on the watch face.
